name: ragbooster
description: Zero-heavy-dependency, LLM-agnostic RAG: BM25 sparse retrieval over document chunks, plus a universal LLM client (OpenAI, Groq, Anthropic, Ollama). Selects the relevant subset of a large corpus that fits inside the target model's existing context window.
author: Daouda Abdoul Anzize
features: Okapi BM25 sparse retrieval (real ranking, not raw keyword-overlap counting)
LLM-agnostic: OpenAI, Groq, Anthropic (correct auth headers), Ollama
State persisted to disk between CLI calls (each call is a separate process)
Optional HTTP server (FastAPI) and Docker image for non-Python callers

functions.name: init
functions.description: Start a session against any LLM endpoint. Writes session state to --state (default .ragbooster/session.json) so subsequent calls in separate processes can find it.

functions.name: load
functions.description: Chunk and index a document (positional text, or --file path) via BM25.

functions.name: ask
functions.description: Retrieve the top-k relevant chunks for the question and ask the configured LLM.

functions.name: stats
functions.returns: dict (total_chunks, indexed_terms, avg_chunk_length_tokens, provider, model, history_turns)

technical_specs.what_this_does_NOT_do: Does not change or extend the target LLM's actual context window size. It selects a relevant subset of a larger corpus so that subset fits inside the window that already exists.
technical_specs.dependency_footprint: requests only for the core library; fastapi+uvicorn only if running as an HTTP service

examples.description: Load a document from a file
